$comment: IBM/HCL WebSphere Commerce (/wcsstore/) with AngularJS and inlined AEM fragments (US store). The server HTML has no price, stock, or gallery src for the main product: and the image carousel are filled by JavaScript, so price is not configured and every product returns price.state 'unknown' with a PRICE_MISSING warning. The only server-side product image is og:image in , so root is the whole document, anchored on the product title. Product URLs are //products/; colour is a query string. The 'Product Specifications' accordion is a per-SKU data-sheet table whose size/sheen/base cells are filled by AngularJS ('--' in the server HTML), so it is not read; specs instead read the server-rendered Options configurator (div.pdp__configurator__field: a label such as 'Container Size:' and a select whose options are the choices), one pair per field with the options joined by ', '. Checked against a saved (curl) paint product page on 2026-11-11.
